outcome: clinical or pathologic accreta diagnosis at follow-up
cohort: 309 patients with pathologically diagnosed placenta accreta in an index pregnancy who did not undergo hysterectomy, of whom 39 returned for a subsequent pregnancy
finding: The risk of major hemorrhagic morbidity after a prior pathologically diagnosed accreta depends on the clinical context, with increased risk in those who experienced hemorrhage or required treatment for retained placenta with accreta in the index pregnancy.
